{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the sales data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Display the shape and info to understand the data
print(sales_df.shape)
print(sales_df.info())

# Check for missing values
print("\nMissing values:")
print(sales_df.isnull().sum())

# Check unique values in 'status' and 'converted' columns
print("\nUnique values in 'status':")
print(sales_df['status'].unique())

print("\nUnique values in 'converted':")
print(sales_df['converted'].unique())

# Check for duplicate rows
print("\nNumber of duplicate rows:", sales_df.duplicated().sum())"}
